title: Add 5 Bulk Action Icons to Selection Bar (Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All)

requirements.text: Add five new bulk action icon buttons to the Selection Bulk Action bar in FileList.tsx, placed immediately after the 'Deselect All' button. The five buttons are: (1) Download All, (2) Favorites All, (3) Shared All, (4) Move All, (5) Delete All. All five buttons must be hidden when only 1 file is selected and must only appear when 2 or more files are selected.

quotes: Add a new five features icons to the 'Selection Bulck action' bar right after the 'Deselect ALL' icon.
Five of these features only work or show up when the user selects more than one file.

acceptanceCriteria: When exactly 1 file is selected, the five new bulk action buttons are not visible.
When 2 or more files are selected, all five new bulk action buttons appear after the Deselect All button in the bulk action bar.
Each button has a distinct, recognizable icon and a tooltip or label: Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All.
The existing per-file three-dot menu items (Preview, Rename, Move, Add to Favorites, Delete) remain unchanged.

requirements.text: Implement the 'Download All' bulk action: when the user clicks Download All with 2+ files selected, trigger a download of each selected file to the user's device using the existing file retrieval mechanism (similar to the single-file download in FilePreview.tsx).

quotes: Download ALL - downloading to any devices

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Download All initiates a download for every selected file.
Each file is downloaded individually to the user's device.
A toast notification confirms the download action was triggered.

requirements.text: Implement the 'Favorites All' bulk action: when the user clicks Favorites All with 2+ files selected, add all selected files to the Favorites section using the existing favorites mutation hook (useAddToFavorites or equivalent from useQueries.ts).

quotes: Favorites ALL - moving to Favorites section

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Favorites All adds all selected files to the Favorites section.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
The Favorites section reflects the newly added files.

requirements.text: Implement the 'Shared All' bulk action: when the user clicks Shared All with 2+ files selected, move or mark all selected files as shared using the existing share mutation hooks from useQueries.ts. If sharing requires a recipient or permission selection, open a minimal dialog to collect the required input.

quotes: Shared ALL - moving to Shared section

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Shared All triggers the share flow for all selected files.
If a dialog is needed for share details, it opens and collects input before proceeding.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
Shared files appear in the Shared section.

requirements.text: Implement the 'Move All' bulk action: when the user clicks Move All with 2+ files selected, open the existing MoveToFolderDialog (or equivalent) configured to move all selected files to a chosen destination folder using the useMoveFilesToFolder mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Move All opens the folder selection dialog.
After confirming a destination, all selected files are moved to that folder.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
The file list updates to reflect the moved files.

requirements.text: Implement the 'Delete All' bulk action: when the user clicks Delete All with 2+ files selected, open a confirmation dialog (reusing or extending DeleteFileDialog/DeleteConfirmationDialog) and upon confirmation, delete all selected files at once using the existing delete mutation hooks.

quotes: Delete All - deleting all filed at once

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Delete All opens a confirmation dialog listing the number of files to be deleted.
Upon confirmation, all selected files are deleted.
A success or error toast notification is shown after the operation.
The file list updates to remove the deleted files.
The selection is cleared after deletion.

constraints: Do not remove or modify the existing per-file three-dot menu items: Preview, Rename, Move, Add to Favorites, Delete.
The five new bulk action buttons must only be visible when 2 or more files are selected.
Reuse existing mutation hooks from useQueries.ts for all backend operations.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding new backend endpoints — all operations must use existing backend mutations.
Modifying the per-file three-dot context menu.
Changing the bulk action bar layout for single-file selections.
Introducing any new authentication or authorization logic.
